structureEvidence.location: official F6420 product/instructions page, product facts and contents
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: F6420 is for 2–6 players and includes six character tokens, six weapon tokens, 50 cards (6 suspect, 6 weapon, 9 room, 29 Clue), one solve envelope, notepad and two dice. The product description says Clue cards can open a new secret passage.

structureEvidence.location: Hasbro F6420 rulebook pp.2–4 and 6; setup diagram and two-player variant
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Official setup diagram shows the nine-room mansion and central envelope; all six suspect figures start at printed colored spaces and six weapons begin in different rooms. The two-player/team setup places four face-down remaining evidence cards in four different rooms, then deals the remaining cards. The rule text also describes a room-connected secret passage.

setupSequence: Place all six suspect figures at their printed colored start spaces, even if fewer than six people play.
Put the six weapon miniatures into six different rooms.
Shuffle suspect, weapon, and room cards by category; put one card of each category into the solution envelope at the mansion center.
Deal the remaining 18 evidence cards to player-private hands; keep the 29 Clue cards as a separate face-down pile.
Give each player a private detective notepad; use both dice for the visible roll/turn checkpoint.
